summary: Van went airborne off Rim Rock Drive at mile marker 18 (east side), landing teetering on a rock pinnacle ~600 ft above the Red Canyon floor; driver extricated via 200-ft rope haul and flown by CareFlight to St. Mary's Hospital
location: Rim Rock Drive, mile 18, Colorado National Monument
responding_agency: NPS rangers, Grand Junction Fire, Mesa County Technical Rescue, Glade Park VFD
